visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens in a brightly lit restaurant with white walls covered in photos and handwriting. A woman with long dark hair, wearing a beige cardigan, sits at a wooden table, bringing a forkful of chocolate cake to her mouth. Beside her, a young girl in a white long-sleeved shirt with a brown bear illustration watches the cake intensely, her face showing a mix of longing and curiosity. (2) The camera zooms in slightly as the woman laughs, covering her mouth with her hand, while the little girl puts her hands to her cheeks and leans forward, making an exaggeratedly cute but yearning expression. (3) A man with glasses is visible in the background, focused on his own meal. The scene cuts to a young boy in a yellow and black hoodie sitting at the same table; a hand enters the frame holding a red cherry, which the boy eagerly tries to catch with his mouth. (4) In the final segment, the little girl is shown looking slightly dejected or pouting, resting her chin on her hand while the woman continues to enjoy her dessert, and various bowls of soup and half-eaten dishes clutter the table surface.
